tools.name: atlas_kit
tools.description: The direction kit for a character state: beat-by-beat behaviour fitted to the shot size (where the tell can be seen), eye life, breath, the target model's rules and a voice delivery line. Write the acting prose from it, then atlas_lint the prose. Paid: $0.10 per call via x402 (USDC on Base), or prepaid credits with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`): 20 for $1.00 with atlas_buy_pack, or by card at https://creatinginai.com/agents#credits.

state.description: The character's state for one beat. Only feels is required.

feels.description: What they feel inside, each with intensity 1-5: a string such as 'fear 4, guilt 3', or a list of {emotion, intensity}.

shows.description: What they show instead: open | deamplify | neutralize | mask-with | amplify | qualify. For mask-with, write 'mask-with:<emotion>' or set with. Default open.

with.description: For mask-with: the emotion shown instead.

control.description: Capacity to hold it right now. Default 3.

tell.description: Size of the tell: 1 trace, 2 flicker, 3 slip, 4 crack, 5 break. Default: suggested from intensity and control.

reveals.description: Who is present, and what is shown or hidden from them.

will.description: feelings they are willing to show that person

wont.description: feelings they won't reveal to that person

because.description: why they hide it, from this person, now

journey.description: arc stage and what they carry in

alone.description: the private beat after the listener leaves

shot.description: Shot size, tightest to widest. Default MCU.

target.description: Target model id, e.g. kling-omni-single, seedance-2, generic-video, qwen-tts, elevenlabs-v3. See atlas_targets.

name.description: Character name as it should appear in the prompt.

eyeline.description: e.g. 'Mum is off frame LEFT; his eyes go LEFT to her'

element.description: Element handle for Elements mode, e.g. @char_noah.

modifiers.description: Modifier ids such as exhausted or child (atlas_search with table modifiers).

tools.name: atlas_draft
tools.description: A first-draft acting paragraph assembled from the kit and fitted to the target's character cap, already linted. It reads mechanically: rewrite it as prose. A voice target gets the delivery line instead. Paid: $0.10 per call via x402 (USDC on Base), or prepaid credits with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`): 20 for $1.00 with atlas_buy_pack, or by card at https://creatinginai.com/agents#credits.

tools.name: atlas_lint
tools.description: Check an acting paragraph or voice direction before spending credits: emotion labels, mugging, looks into the lens, quoted speech on hosts that block it, a tell bigger than the state allows, and the target's character cap. ok is true when there are no errors; each finding carries its fix. Free.

text.description: The paragraph or voice direction to check.

target.description: Target model id, e.g. kling-omni-single, seedance-2, generic-video, qwen-tts, elevenlabs-v3. See atlas_targets.

shot.description: Shot size, tightest to widest. Default MCU.

state.description: Optional: the state the text performs, to check the tell size.

feels.description: What they feel inside, each with intensity 1-5: a string such as 'fear 4, guilt 3', or a list of {emotion, intensity}.

shows.description: What they show instead: open | deamplify | neutralize | mask-with | amplify | qualify. For mask-with, write 'mask-with:<emotion>' or set with. Default open.

with.description: For mask-with: the emotion shown instead.

wont.description: feelings they won't reveal to that person

because.description: why they hide it, from this person, now

journey.description: arc stage and what they carry in

alone.description: the private beat after the listener leaves

tell.description: Optional, without a state: the largest tell allowed.

cracks_if.description: Optional, with tell: what cracks the mask.

tools.name: atlas_search
tools.description: Full-text search across behaviour cues, FACS action units, expressions, display strategies, emotions, situations, modifiers, model notes and targets. Search by emotion or situation; what comes back is behaviour. Free.

table.description: Limit to one table, e.g. cues, action_units, expressions, emotions, situations, modifiers, model_notes, targets.

shot.description: Shot size, tightest to widest. Default MCU.

channel.description: Limit to one leak channel id, e.g. lc-hands.

tools.name: atlas_show
tools.description: One atlas record by id (or an emotion by name), with the records that use it. Free.

id.description: A record id from a kit or search, or an emotion name.

tools.name: atlas_targets
tools.description: The target models the atlas knows, with each prompt field's character cap and what the model needs. Pass a target id to atlas_kit, atlas_draft and atlas_lint. Free.

tools.name: atlas_journey
tools.description: A character's arc beat by beat, with continuity flags: reset (intensity drops with no event), breach (a hidden feeling shown to the person it's hidden from), overshoot (a tell bigger than the feeling) and flat (beats that never change). Fields a beat leaves out carry over from the beat before. Free.

characters.description: Character id -> list of beats. Each beat is a state (feels, shows, control, tell, reveals...) plus at (beat id) and event.

project.description: Local only: a production folder holding journey.yaml.

tools.name: atlas_buy_pack
tools.description: Buy 20 paid calls for $1.00 in one x402 payment (USDC on Base). Returns an API key: send it as an `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header (or in params._meta["creatinginai/pack"]) on atlas_kit or atlas_draft instead of paying per call. Each successful call uses one credit; failed calls are free.
